entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker called the Lithomancer who shapes stone and metal, protects Zendikar, and builds the hedron network that imprisons the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker and protector of Innistrad, over a thousand years old, who fights the Eldrazi alongside Nahiri.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ancient ethereal dragon and planeswalker who devises the plan to imprison the three Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Lian
entities.description: A cold-eyed refugee girl of about fifteen whom Nahiri arms with a stone sword; she is snatched away as the plane collapses.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: The smallest of the three Eldrazi titans, the enormous creature seen destroying the first doomed world.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that picks its way through the hedron fields, surrounded by black obsidian blades.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan, a tower of latticed flesh and tentacles floating above the others.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: World-devouring beings native to the Blind Eternities, whose three true titans lead a brood of spawn.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's protected home plane, chosen to become the Eldrazi's prison.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Sorin's home plane, which he did not offer as a rendezvous.

entities.name: The doomed plane
aliases: a plane whose name is lost to history
entities.description: A plane whose name is lost to history, more than 6,000 years ago, where Nahiri and Sorin defend refugees until it is unraveled by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A rugged, volcanic highland of Zendikar where Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin meet and where the Eldrazi are finally held.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: A rolling region of Zendikar Nahiri senses through the earth.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: A river-crossed region of Zendikar.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A boiling, sulfurous region of Zendikar.

entities.name: Sejiri
entities.description: An icy region of Zendikar.

entities.name: Silundi Sea
entities.description: A sea on Zendikar.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, native home of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Æther
entities.description: The substance from which the Eldrazi's true forms are made and from which they cast physical projections.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Carefully crafted stone shapes pulled from the earth by Nahiri and runed by Ugin to lure and bind the Eldrazi to Zendikar.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The underground chamber at the nexus of the hedron network, sealed with a lock that only three Planeswalkers can open.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A people of Zendikar who live in temporary settlements in Akoum.

events.summary: Nahiri raises a stone rampart around a refugee camp, though she knows it will not hold against the monstrous creatures overrunning the plane.
events.quote: Nahiri, called the Lithomancer, surveyed her work and frowned.

events.summary: Sorin urges Nahiri to leave the refugees and focus on stopping the creatures before they spread to other worlds; Nahiri insists they are there to save the people.
events.quote: I'm here to stop these creatures, on this world, before they spread to others—to mine, or to yours.

events.summary: Sorin admits that they are not winning against the creatures.
events.quote: No," he said.

events.summary: Nahiri melts stone with an old spell and draws out a sword for Lian, telling her the world is hers to fight for.
events.quote: She pulled, and an elegant blade slid free of the molten rock.

events.summary: An enormous Eldrazi rises beyond the valley and the brood surges toward the camp.
events.quote: Then a figure, impossibly large, rose up behind the hills on the far side of the valley.

events.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Lian fight the first wave of Eldrazi brood at the wall, but the titan's pull drains their magic.
events.quote: Nahiri could feel her mana spiraling away even as she gathered it.

events.summary: The plane begins to come apart as a crack in the world opens and the refugees are swept away.
events.quote: The plane was coming apart.

events.summary: Sorin flashes away and Lian is taken by the light; Nahiri grabs the sword and planeswalks off the dying world.
events.quote: Silently cursing herself, Nahiri grabbed the sword and left the world behind.

events.summary: Nahiri and Sorin regroup at a kor settlement in Akoum on Zendikar.
events.quote: Nahiri clutched the sword, the last trace of a now-dead world.

events.summary: Ugin appears as a luminous dragon, and Nahiri meets him for the first time.
events.quote: Then he was there with them: a massive, ethereal dragon, shining with blue-white light.

events.summary: Ugin reveals he watched the destruction without helping, in order to learn about the Eldrazi, and explains what they are and why they cannot simply be killed.
events.quote: They're called the Eldrazi," said Ugin, "and they devour entire worlds.

events.summary: Ugin proposes imprisoning the three true Eldrazi on a single plane, binding them with physical anchors and forcing them into dormancy.
events.quote: Bind them to one plane using their physical forms as anchors, and force them into dormancy.

events.summary: Ugin describes the ideal prison world, and Nahiri realizes he means Zendikar, refusing at first.
events.quote: What gives me the right to put everyone here in danger?

events.summary: Ugin explains he chose Zendikar because it has a protector, and asks for Nahiri's help rather than forcing her.
events.quote: No," said Ugin. "Because I also need your help.

events.summary: Nahiri decides that Zendikar will be the Eldrazi's prison and she their jailer, and agrees to the plan.
events.quote: Zendikar would be their prison, Nahiri their jailer, one world and one Planeswalker standing steadfast to protect all others.

events.summary: Over forty years, Nahiri pulls hedrons from the earth and Ugin etches them with runes, creating a trap and a lure for the Eldrazi.
events.quote: It took forty years of near-constant work.

events.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's peoples of the coming Eldrazi as the titans slowly approach the hedron-lit plane.
events.quote: Nahiri spread word throughout the plane of what was coming

events.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
events.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

events.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin focus their power in the Eye of Ugin and shift every hedron into its final position, completing the network.
events.quote: Every single hedron on the plane glowed as they shifted into new positions.

events.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
events.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

events.summary: Nahiri vows that her work is just beginning as she looks up at the imprisoned titans.
events.quote: My work is just beginning.

relations.note: Fellow planeswalkers fighting together, though Nahiri is unsure he is truly a friend.
relations.quote: the closest thing she had to a friend in this place so far from the world of her birth.

relations.note: She agrees to work with Ugin to imprison the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Three of them, three of us. Together, we can save everything that is.

relations.note: They have worked together in the past, though not recently.
relations.quote: We have worked amicably together in the past,

relations.note: She is guardian of Zendikar, which is under her protection.
relations.quote: I am Nahiri, guardian of Zendikar,
vampire, fellow Planeswalker, protector of the plane called Innistrad

relations.note: She pulls the hedrons out of the earth.
relations.quote: One by one, she pulled carefully crafted stone shapes out of the earth

relations.note: She fights the Eldrazi and imprisons their titans.
relations.quote: Zendikar would be their prison, Nahiri their jailer
We can imprison them," said Ugin.

relations.note: They are native to the Blind Eternities.
relations.quote: They are living organisms, apparently native to the Blind Eternities—the only such creatures known to exist.

relations.note: One of the three true Eldrazi titans.
relations.quote: The one Sorin and Nahiri had seen before, the enormous thing that Ugin called Ulamog, was in fact the smallest of the three.
